repair.method: Parse Python source structurally and inspect complete literal bundle shapes without concatenating independent malformed fixture fragments.

issues.after: Observed and claim-sensitive artifacts remain immutable under development override attempts.
issues.before: Observed overwrite exploit was reproducible in the original audit.
issues.expected_security_or_evidence_behavior: Reject overwrite before any protected byte changes.
issues.fixture_or_artifact: Temporary OBSERVED manifest and claim-sensitive payloads exercised through the development writer.
issues.original_exploit: A development override could overwrite or downgrade an existing OBSERVED or claim-sensitive artifact.
issues.title: Observed overwrite

issues.after: A caller-constructed split or arbitrary freeze identity cannot authorize confirmatory execution.
issues.before: Fake confirmatory split/freeze exploit was reproducible in the original audit.
issues.expected_security_or_evidence_behavior: Reject arbitrary authority and detect complete embedded bundles without joining unrelated fragments.
issues.fixture_or_artifact: Forged temporary split/freeze envelopes and complete/fragmented Python literal bundle fixtures.
issues.original_exploit: Caller-created split/freeze identities or fragmented source literals could authorize or confuse confirmatory isolation.
issues.title: Fake confirmatory split/freeze

issues.after: P3 retention is recomputed from authenticated development evidence; a forged retained flag fails closed.
issues.before: Forged P3 gate exploit was reproducible in the original audit.
issues.expected_security_or_evidence_behavior: Recompute the gate and reject the forged retained state.
issues.fixture_or_artifact: Temporary forged retained decision with checksum-bound development gate inputs.
issues.original_exploit: A forged persisted P3 retained flag could bypass the authenticated development gate computation.
issues.title: Forged P3 gate

issues.after: Synthetic adapters stay synthetic and on-disk OBSERVED relabeling fails validation.
issues.before: Fake resource adapter OBSERVED exploit was reproducible in the original audit.
issues.expected_security_or_evidence_behavior: Keep the adapter synthetic and reject the forged observation at validation.
issues.fixture_or_artifact: Synthetic adapter run plus an on-disk forced-OBSERVED tamper fixture.
issues.original_exploit: A fake resource adapter or an on-disk status edit could be relabelled OBSERVED.
issues.title: Fake resource adapter OBSERVED

issues.after: Synthetic storage remains non-observed, non-claimable, and cannot support H7 after caller flag forgery.
issues.before: Synthetic storage to H7 exploit was reproducible in the original audit.
issues.expected_security_or_evidence_behavior: Discovery must retain SYNTHETIC_TEST origin; selection must reject it and H7 must remain NOT_EXECUTED.
issues.fixture_or_artifact: Controlled synthetic storage packages in temporary external normal-layout evidence roots, including forged eligibility flags.
issues.original_exploit: Synthetic image-storage data could be promoted through a normal-looking package to support H7.
issues.title: Synthetic storage to H7

issues.after: Confirmatory classification cannot be forged over development or otherwise non-confirmatory gold provenance.
issues.before: Forbidden gold classification exploit was reproducible in the original audit.
issues.expected_security_or_evidence_behavior: Recompute source classification and reject the wrapper.
issues.fixture_or_artifact: Temporary development gold source wrapped in a forged confirmatory classification.
issues.original_exploit: A caller could label development gold as confirmatory.
issues.title: Forbidden gold classification

issues.after: Robustness draft generation is prohibited for confirmatory families.
issues.before: Confirmatory robustness generation exploit was reproducible in the original audit.
issues.original_exploit: The robustness generator could create variants for confirmatory families.
issues.title: Confirmatory robustness generation

issues.after: CUDA availability requires the exact runtime contract; missing site packages cannot become success.
issues.before: False CUDA success exploit was reproducible in the original audit.
issues.expected_security_or_evidence_behavior: Classify the probe unavailable, never successful.
issues.fixture_or_artifact: Synthetic CUDA process response with site-packages deliberately absent.
issues.original_exploit: A CUDA probe could report success without the required site-packages contract.
issues.title: False CUDA success

issues.after: Timeout and interrupt paths deterministically clean the exact container or pod and preserve lifecycle failure state.
issues.before: Lifecycle and cleanup exploit was reproducible in the original audit.
issues.expected_security_or_evidence_behavior: Remove the exact object and preserve the failure state on every branch.
issues.fixture_or_artifact: Fake Docker/Kubernetes clients exercising timeout and interrupt lifecycle branches.
issues.original_exploit: Timeout or interrupt paths could leak the exact Docker container or Kubernetes pod and obscure lifecycle failure.
issues.title: Lifecycle and cleanup

issues.after: E5 provenance is derived from a verified recommendation run; wrong or stale caller input fails before execution.
issues.before: Caller-supplied E5 provenance exploit was reproducible in the original audit.
issues.expected_security_or_evidence_behavior: Reject provenance before any image execution.
issues.original_exploit: Caller-supplied wrong or stale recommendation provenance could reach E5 execution.
issues.title: Caller-supplied E5 provenance

issues.after: Catalog-scale scoring requires canonical v2 acceptable gold and cannot infer it from a v1-shaped record.
issues.before: V1-shaped catalog scale scorer exploit was reproducible in the original audit.
issues.expected_security_or_evidence_behavior: Reject catalog-scale scoring rather than infer missing gold.
issues.fixture_or_artifact: Temporary v1-shaped catalog-scale storage metric record lacking canonical v2 acceptable gold.
issues.original_exploit: A v1-shaped storage record could be scored as though canonical v2 acceptable-gold were present.
issues.title: V1-shaped catalog scale scorer

issues.after: Caller-duplicated provenance cannot override canonical source identity or a production-freeze mismatch.
issues.before: Freeze mismatch exploit was reproducible in the original audit.
issues.expected_security_or_evidence_behavior: Reject the selected evidence and block the affected requirement.
issues.fixture_or_artifact: Verified test freeze plus deliberately mismatched canonical/caller dataset identities.
issues.original_exploit: Duplicated caller provenance could override a canonical source identity or production-freeze mismatch.
issues.title: Freeze mismatch

issues.after: The final audit consumes authenticated selected claims and renders statuses, values, counts, P3/E3/E4/E5 states, and prose from them.
issues.before: Hardcoded final report exploit was reproducible in the original audit.
issues.expected_security_or_evidence_behavior: Derive status, metrics, intervals, counts, reasons, prose, and completion propagation from evaluated evidence.
issues.fixture_or_artifact: Authenticated current package plus isolated empty, observed-path, incomplete, and non-empty-selection propagation fixtures.
issues.original_exploit: The final report could discard selected evidence or hardcode the current all-NOT_EXECUTED snapshot.
issues.title: Hardcoded final report

issues.after: The public draft CLI fails closed on confirmatory input.
issues.before: Draft CLI isolation exploit was reproducible in the original audit.
issues.expected_security_or_evidence_behavior: Exit nonzero before producing a draft.
issues.fixture_or_artifact: Temporary confirmatory input passed through the public draft CLI.
issues.original_exploit: The public robustness draft CLI could accept confirmatory input even if the internal generator refused it.
issues.title: Draft CLI isolation

issues.after: All bounded legacy E4 directories validate under explicit compatibility semantics without promotion to observed evidence.
issues.before: E4 legacy compatibility exploit was reproducible in the original audit.
issues.expected_security_or_evidence_behavior: Validate under bounded compatibility rules without OBSERVED or claim-eligible promotion.
issues.fixture_or_artifact: All 20 preserved repository E4 legacy directories.
issues.original_exploit: Legacy E4 directories could either evade validation or be promoted under current semantics.
issues.title: E4 legacy compatibility

issues.after: Historical bytes and identity are preserved while a new LF-policy compatibility package records its own checksum.
issues.before: E3 newline/checksum exploit was reproducible in the original audit.
issues.expected_security_or_evidence_behavior: Preserve both identities and bind the derivative explicitly to the historical source.
issues.fixture_or_artifact: Preserved E3 participant-flow.csv and its versioned LF/current-policy derivative manifest.
issues.original_exploit: Newline normalization could silently replace the preserved E3 participant-flow identity.
issues.title: E3 newline/checksum

revision_model.self_reference_policy: Never claim the enclosing future publication commit was the tested commit.

remaining_real_execution_requirements: authoritative freeze, sealed split/custody, and isolation gates must pass
E6: no confirmatory execution is authorized unless a frozen authenticated development gate retains P3 (current state NOT_RETAINED_OR_NOT_PRESENT)
